description.zh:
挂载模式。取值范围：
```
create_new_mount_point - 创建新挂载点（默认值）
use_exist_mount_point - 使用已有挂载点
```
description.en:
The attach mode. Valid values:

```
create_new_mount_point - Create a new mount target (default)
use_exist_mount_point - Use an existing mount target
```

description.zh: 挂载点路径，不填写则随机生成。
description.en: The path of the mount target. If you do not specify this parameter, a path is randomly generated.
The ID of the destination ECS instance.

description.zh:
待挂载的数据库文件系统ID。
数据库文件系统（FsId）和ECS实例（ECSInstanceId）必须在同一个可用区内。
description.en:
The ID of the database file system to attach.
The database file system (FsId) and the ECS instance (ECSInstanceId) must be in the same zone.

description.zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) operation to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh: DBFS软件包地址，已废弃不再使用。
description.en: The address of the DBFS package. This parameter is deprecated.

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

数据库文件系统的状态必须为待挂载（Unattached）。
挂载数据库文件系统时，目标ECS实例必须处于运行中（Running）状态。
descriptions.en:
Note:

The database file system must be in the Unattached state.
The destination ECS instance must be in the Running state.
